project.title: Matrixly Agent Pilot — Support + Shipping
project.summary: Acme wants to reduce WISMO tickets and improve first-response time with SupportForge and Shipping Assistant agents, with human approval on external actions.
goals: Deploy SupportForge widget on help center
Integrate ShipStation status into agent answers
constraints: Must keep human approval before customer-facing refunds
Brand voice must match Acme help center tone

notes: Include mutual success criteria and weekly review call.
